title: Choose the visual world
question: Three re-rolls in. These are the last remaining academic forms, plus Canvas / Moodle / Coursera played straight. If you still re-roll, use steer to name the quality that was missing — otherwise the next hand has nothing familiar left to deal.

options.label: Swiss Identity Poster
options.lineage: Swiss academic identity posters (ETH-era information grids)
options.thesis: The landing is one poster: the academy’s identity grid, the path as numbered fields, enroll as the only primary.
options.viewport: A full-bleed poster: SKILLSTREAM ACADEMY in grotesque, 1 Enroll 2 Learn 3 Certify as a numbered grid, Sign in as student in the red field, Check a reference as the registration number in the margin, Planned as an empty ruled cell.
options.risk: A generic modernist poster if the grid is decoration instead of the path.

options.label: Circulation Card
options.lineage: Library due-date cards in book pockets
options.thesis: The course is checked out on a circulation card: stamps are progress, the card number is the certificate reference.
options.viewport: A due-date card filling the viewport: borrower line as student, date grid as lessons, last stamp as certified, card number as verify; Sign in as checking the card out; Planned as unstamped empty rows.
options.risk: Library nostalgia if the stamps are decoration instead of enroll → complete → issue.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Canvas, Moodle, Coursera: a type-first LMS hero, three steps, and Sign in — executed at their craft level.
canonCard.viewport: Type-first hero, path card, feature list, Sign in.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the current shell by design.
